8750.headline: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0
paragraphs: Thu Sep 17, at home at Rink 1: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0. That puts the season at 1-0.

Matthew Killeen opened the scoring at 10:05 of the second on the power play, from John Shortreed and Dylan Tadros (1-0). Christopher Mayor made it 2-0 at 1:47 of the second on the power play, from Alex Albano. ✎ Ryan Smith made it 3-0 at 2:44 of the third, from Kevin Zimmerman.

Scoring for Mid Ice Crisis: Christopher Mayor (1G), Matthew Killeen (1G) and Ryan Smith (1G). Game-winner: Matthew Killeen at 10:05 of the second. 6 PIM for Mid Ice Crisis (3 minors: High-Sticking, Roughing).

8748.headline: PB Hooker$ D blank Fire Truck Club D 8-0
paragraphs: Wed Sep 16, on the road at Rink 2: PB Hooker$ D blank Fire Truck Club D 8-0. That puts the season at 1-0.

Jason Sager opened the scoring at 5:28 of the first, from Louis Schulze and Andrew Kulnick (1-0). Paul Onorati made it 2-0 at 4:31 of the first, from Dan Altman. Paul Onorati made it 3-0 at 1:19 of the first, from Jason Sager and Roma Zidan. Carvey Iannuzzi made it 4-0 at 9:17 of the second, from Jeremiah Cannon and Fernando Aguirre. Fernando Aguirre made it 5-0 at 7:14 of the second. Vladimir Shtutman made it 6-0 at 6:16 of the second, from Carvey Iannuzzi and Roma Zidan. Thomas Devito made it 7-0 at 11:16 of the third. Carvey Iannuzzi made it 8-0 at 4:31 of the third.
Scoring for PB Hooker$ D: Carvey Iannuzzi (2G 1A), Paul Onorati (2G) and Fernando Aguirre (1G 1A). Game-winner: Jason Sager at 5:28 of the first. No penalties for PB Hooker$ D.
